issues.description: `cur_entry` does not expose that its returned `Entry.node` is the current path node, so the map caller cannot prove the returned PTE address relative to `cur_entry.node`.
issues.rationale: `Entry::new_at` constructs its result with the input `node` and specifies the PTE address relative to that input, but omits `res.node == node`. `cur_entry` therefore relates the PTE to the current path node without relating its returned `res.node` to that node. In the `Child::None` map branch, the assertion using `cur_entry.node` fails modular verification. Repair 15b5ddbb adds the construction identity and propagates the derived address relation through `cur_entry`; the same assertion then verifies.
issues.source_evidence: after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/cursor/mod.rs:319-341 specifies `cur_entry` only against the path node, while lines 566-569 assert the address against `cur_entry.node`. after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/node/entry.rs:177-203 constructs `Self { ..., node, ... }` but omits the corresponding identity postcondition. Repair 15b5ddbb625c562138b416f4f73b8c39c8b09172 adds `res.node == node` to `Entry::new_at` and the PTE/node address postcondition to `cur_entry`.
issues.verification: With compatible historical Verus, the exact selected merge reports vstd_extra 228/0 and lock-protocol 496/1, failing the labeled assertion at cursor/mod.rs:566. Direct repair 15b5ddbb reports 228/0 and 497/0. Primary and independent reviews confirmed the merge ancestry and two-layer contract repair.
